summary: The notation and spacing repairs are complete. Direct reading of selected passages from the two named primary sources supports the manuscript’s attribution and claim distinctions. Manual comparison identified no distinctive unattributed extended prose match in those passages; this is a bounded accessible-source review, not a corpus-wide originality assessment.
